item.title: 【Live Video Artist's Collections】I.O.I Performance & Content Collection (2016, 2017 + 2026) (200+GB)
item.description:
Hello beautiful peeps

I really love a lot of the I.O.I members and seeing 9 of them performing together again has been a dream come true! ~ hopefully one day we will get to see all 11 on stage together again ~

During their 10th anniversary reunion I collected a lot of shows and performances they were on as well as some other stuff.

The main things you'll find in the drive include:

> Performances from 2016, 2017, and 2026
> Music Videos
> Shows from 2026 (first, next, viu rips, and Youtube shows - eng subs if I could find)
> Shows from 2016-2017 that are subbed + hardsubbed (720p+1080p) - thanks to teamidealsubs, teamdoyeon, and Yubseyo <3

If you have anything I don't have or have anything in higher quality please feel free to send, I would really appreciate it! If you'd like to be credited please mention how you'd like to be credited <3

p.s.
Please don't share on other platforms I don't want to risk my google drive being copyrighted and terminated, thanks!
